item.title: Eury Perez tosses first career complete game to blank Braves
item.description: Eury Perez didn't allow a hit for five innings and pitched his first career complete game as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Atlanta Braves 3-0 on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Eury Perez didn't allow a hit for five innings and pitched his first career complete game as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Atlanta Braves 3-0 on Friday night. Marlins rookie catcher Joe Mack broke a scoreless tie in the seventh inning with his 14th homer of the season. Perez (8-11) set a career high in wins, one more than last year. He allowed just one hit and one walk, striking out eight. No Braves player reached second base. Braves catcher Sean Murphy broke up Perez's no-hit bid with a 108-mph single on the first pitch of the sixth inning. Grant Holmes (10-6), used in relief for just the second time this year, took the loss. He pitched four innings and allowed just three hits, including Mack's homer, three walks and one run. One of the early highlights in this game was a diving stop by Marlins second baseman Jared Serna, who got to his feet in time to throw out Drake Baldwin at first. Miami nearly scored in the fifth as Mack and Otto Lopez walked before Jakob Marsee's 387-foot drive was caught on the warning track by center fielder Michael Harris II, ending the inning. The seventh inning featured more stellar defense for the Marlins. Shortstop Lopez threw out Harris on a 112-mph grounder, and third baseman Javier Sanoja made a diving stop to throw out Mauricio Dubon at first. Mack put the Marlins in front in the seventh when he drove Holmes' curveball 428 feet to right for his 14th homer. The blast had an exit velocity of 108 mph. Miami extended its lead in the eighth as Marsee tripled and scored on Heriberto Hernandez's single over second baseman Ozzie Albies as Atlanta was playing its infield in to try to keep Marsee from scoring. Then, with two outs in the inning, Griffin Conine added a solo homer to give Miami its 3-0 lead, and Perez did the rest, finishing with 105 pitches. --Field Level Media

item.title: Freddy Peralta, Rays staff flummox Phillies
item.description: Freddy Peralta and four relievers combined on a four-hitter as the visiting Tampa Bay Rays topped the Philadelphia Phillies 2-0 on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Freddy Peralta and four relievers combined on a four-hitter as the visiting Tampa Bay Rays topped the Philadelphia Phillies 2-0 on Friday. Nick Fortes homered for Tampa Bay (97-63), which has already clinched the top seed in the American League playoffs but continued to pile on against a Philadelphia team with plenty to play for. The Phillies (87-73) came in with a magic number of two to clinch a wild-card berth but now will have to sweat out the final two days of the regular season. Peralta (10-11) gave up four hits -- all singles -- in 5 1/3 innings. He also yielded three walks, but the right-hander worked around the damage to get the best of Cristopher Sanchez (18-7). The Philadelphia lefty struck out 10 in seven innings, allowing two runs and five hits. Tampa Bay scored a first-inning run against Sanchez, who recorded the first two outs before allowing singles to Junior Caminero and Ryan Vilade. Jonny DeLuca sent the next pitch into right field for an RBI single. The Rays only needed one swing to double their lead in the second inning. Fortes launched an 0-1 sinker from Sanchez over the wall in left field for his sixth homer of the season. The Phillies had a baserunner against Peralta in each of the first five innings, but they were unable to dent the scoreboard. In the sixth, Trea Turner and Bryce Harper singled against Peralta and moved into scoring position on a groundout. Peralta then gave way to Cam Booser, who got Bryson Stott on a liner to second and Bryan De La Cruz on a liner to shortstop. Kevin Kelly came on for the seventh and retired the Phillies in order. Cole Sulser logged the eighth and took care of the top three hitters in the Philadelphia lineup. Bryan Baker worked a perfect ninth to pick up his 41st save. Tampa Bay outfielder Chandler Simpson exited after fouling a ball off his foot in the sixth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Saudi says it intercepted 2 drones launched by Houthis towards Riyadh
item.description: Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early on Saturday it had intercepted two drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthis towards the Saudi capital Riyadh.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Yemen's Saudi-led coalition said early on Saturday it had intercepted two drones launched by the Iran-backed Houthis towards the Saudi capital Riyadh. The coalition posted on X that it was monitoring missile threat and drones launched at the kingdom without providing further details. The Saudi civil defence had sent alerts overnight for Khamis Mushait and Abha but not for the capital. The Houthis, who control the most populous parts of Yemen and much of the north, have been launching attacks against Saudi Arabia since declaring a naval blockade against Riyadh in July, with strikes targeting Saudi vessels in the Red Sea. The attacks have targeted Saudi cities, energy infrastructure and shipping, adding to pressures on global oil supplies caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran and putting at risk the main alternative Red Sea route for Gulf exports while traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely blocked.

item.title: Colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos, incluido el fracking y buscará alianzas con EEUU: presidente
item.description: El Grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementará el fracking y continuará explorando yacimientos offshore para incrementar las reservas de hidrocarburos, dijo el viernes el nuevo presidente del conglomerado, Joaquín Gutiérrez.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Grupo energético colombiano Ecopetrol avanzará en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementará el fracking y continuará explorando yacimientos offshore para incrementar las reservas de hidrocarburos, dijo el viernes el nuevo presidente del conglomerado, Joaquín Gutiérrez. Además, el directivo anunció que la petrolera, la empresa más grande del país sudamericano, buscará alianzas con Estados Unidos para ser incluido entre los países con condiciones favorables para hacer negocios. Gutiérrez, un administrador de empresas que fue jefe de campaña del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella, agregó que dirigirá el conglomerado energético con austeridad, al tiempo que fortalecerá el gobierno corporativo, los controles sobre el grupo y la seguridad de las operaciones. "Avanzaremos en proyectos convencionales y no convencionales, implementaremos fracking responsable y continuaremos explorando yacimientos offshore", dijo Gutiérrez durante el acto de su posesión, acompañado por De La Espriella. Ecopetrol sufrió numerosas controversias durante la anterior administración, mientras fue presidida por Ricardo Roa, quien renunció a finales de julio y está vinculado a una investigación como presunto responsable del delito de violación de límites de gastos en la campaña electoral que llevó al poder al expresidente Gustavo Petro en 2022. Roa también enfrenta otro proceso relacionado con posible tráfico de influencias por la compra de un apartamento a una persona a la que después le adjudicó un contrato en un proyecto de gas. Además, el conglomerado fue foco de controversias por numerosos nombramientos de personas cercanas a Petro, por lo que actualmente surten investigaciones de organismos de control. De La Espriella reiteró su interés por reiniciar la firma de nuevos contratos de exploración y producción de hidrocarburos ante la necesidad de incrementar las alicaídas reservas de crudo y gas del país. "Las reservas hay que encontrarlas donde quiera que estén, ese es uno de los grandes desafíos que recibe hoy Joaquín Gutiérrez", dijo el mandatario. "Esas cifras (de reservas) obligan a actuar porque un país que renuncia torpemente a buscar sus recursos termina indefectiblemente obligado a comprárselos a otro país". Ecopetrol, controlada en un 88,5% por el Estado colombiano, genera la mayor parte de la producción de petróleo del país y es propietaria de las dos principales refinerías, así como de la mayor parte de la red de oleoductos y poliductos.

item.title: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold (glute) cleared for Week 3 return
item.description: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is ready to return from a glute injury and will start Sunday against the Washington Commanders.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is ready to return from a glute injury and will start Sunday against the Washington Commanders. Coach Mike Macdonald confirmed Friday that Darnold has been cleared after progressing from limited work Wednesday to full participation in each of the past two practices. "Sam's gonna play, and he's ready to go," Macdonald said. "He's done a great job." Darnold was injured on Seattle's opening possession of a 13-10 Week 1 victory over the New England Patriots. He completed 1 of 2 passes for 13 yards before leaving the game and later underwent testing that ruled out a more serious hip injury. The 29-year-old acknowledged Thursday that the initial uncertainty left him concerned about both the remainder of his season and possible long-term effects. Those fears eased considerably over the past two weeks. "He looks great, so we're rolling," Macdonald said Friday. "It's a medical miracle he's back." Drew Lock handled the quarterback duties after Darnold went down and started last week's 31-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals, helping the defending Super Bowl champions improve to 2-0. Darnold is coming off his first season with Seattle, when he passed for 4,048 yards, 25 touchdowns and 14 interceptions while starting all 17 games. The Seahawks won a franchise-record 14 regular-season games before defeating New England 29-13 in Super Bowl LX. While Seattle gets its quarterback back, its secondary will be short-handed in Washington. Starting safeties Julian Love and Ty Okada have both been ruled out. Love sustained a calf injury during practice Thursday, while Okada remains sidelined by a hamstring issue. --Field Level Media

item.title: South Africa open to more talks with US after visa dispute, minister says
item.description: South Africa remains open to talks with the US on areas of dispute, including rules for foreign investors on Black employment and ownership, although it was surprised by last week's US visa restrictions, South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Doyinsola Oladipo
item.content:encoded: South Africa remains open to talks with the US on areas of dispute, including rules for foreign investors on Black employment and ownership, although it was surprised by last week's US visa restrictions, South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola said on Friday. The two countries were discussing ways to accommodate new US entrants into South Africa's mining sector, among other matters, Lamola said, and were making progress when Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced curbs on visas for South Africans, citing concerns over its laws and policies. He did not specify who would be subject to the ban. "South Africa remains open to engage with the U.S. administration on all the issues that they have put on the table," Lamola said in an interview on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. "We are predictable and reliable partners, and we see the U.S. as an important strategic partner." President Donald Trump's administration has [USN:L8N3RS0M7 TEXT:"criticized South Africa"] over a range of issues including actions aimed at addressing racial inequality, which he says hurt the African nation's white population. While South Africa has [USN:L8N4580PB TEXT:"criticized the new visa restrictions"], Lamola said Pretoria did not want a “tit-for-tat war” with Washington over the issue, given the importance of the economic relationship, but said the current US administration was unpredictable. "You can't be confident of anything with the current administration, and it's not only Pretoria. I think all countries of the world, the friends and foes of the US view it the same," he said. Washington is also pressing Pretoria over its land reform policies and its genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice. Lamola called Washington's resettlement program for white Afrikaners a "race-based" program and questioned their designation as refugees, saying some continued to visit South Africa after leaving. He said Pretoria, however, would neither stop nor interfere with South Africans who choose to participate. On South Africa's genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice, Lamola said the case “has to have a life of its own” and must be decided by the court, with international law serving as an “equalizer amongst nations, big and small.” After the announcement of visa restrictions on September 15, the US ambassador to South Africa said they were "only the first step in a series of escalatory measures" and that the time for endless dialogue had run its course. "If you can't dialog and you want to declare that dialog has run its course, you are in the wrong profession — you are not a diplomat," said Lamola, adding that only Washington knows if the relationship will recover.

item.title: OpenAI's models accessed public US Census, SEC data, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: OpenAI's models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: OpenAI's models accessed publicly available information from US government websites, including those of the Census Bureau and the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bloomberg News reported on Friday. The company's agentic AI systems interacted with SEC.gov, Investor.gov and publicly available Census.gov data, the report said, citing people familiar with the situation. Asked for comment, an OpenAI spokesperson said the company was "conducting an extensive review of misaligned model activity and notifying organizations when we identify potential impacts to their systems. We expect to make additional notifications as that work continues." The review has mostly found "routine research tasks," and "some involved government websites because our models often turn to them as authoritative sources of public information," the spokesperson said in a statement.

item.title: Prometidas eleições na Venezuela enfrentam longos atrasos, dizem fontes
item.description: A tão esperada votação na Venezuela pode não ocorrer por um ano ou mais devido às reformas previstas nos tribunais e nas autoridades eleitorais, disseram cinco fontes políticas e analistas, apesar da promessa da presidente interina Delcy Rodríguez de uma transição para a “democracia plena”.
item.dc:creator: Vivian Sequera, Mayela Armas, Anthony Esposito
item.content:encoded: A tão esperada votação na Venezuela pode não ocorrer por um ano ou mais devido às reformas previstas nos tribunais e nas autoridades eleitorais, disseram cinco fontes políticas e analistas, apesar da promessa da presidente interina Delcy Rodríguez de uma transição para a “democracia plena”. Rodríguez, que assumiu o poder após uma operação dos Estados Unidos capturar o então presidente Nicolás Maduro em janeiro, disse à Assembleia Geral da ONU na quarta-feira que as instituições do Estado estavam se preparando para as eleições. Segundo ela, o governo havia iniciado negociações com a oposição e garantiria a participação plena, mas não apresentou um cronograma. Cinco fontes, incluindo representantes de partidos próximos ao governo e à oposição, assim como analistas, afirmaram que ainda existem grandes obstáculos, como reformas institucionais complexas e pouca urgência aparente por parte de Washington para a realização de uma votação imediata. Duas das fontes disseram à Reuters que é improvável que haja eleições antes do final do próximo ano. REFORMAS COMPLEXAS No centro do atraso está a previsão de substituição de todos os 32 juízes da Suprema Corte e dos cinco diretores do Conselho Nacional Eleitoral, órgão eleitoral máximo. Grupos da oposição e observadores internacionais de direitos humanos vêm afirmando que os dois órgãos carecem de independência e que as reeleições de Maduro em 2018 e 2024 foram fraudulentas. A reforma institucional está sendo discutida em negociações apoiadas pelos EUA entre o governo interino de Rodríguez e uma facção da oposição. Mas mesmo após a posse de um novo conselho eleitoral, as autoridades ainda precisariam atualizar os cadernos eleitorais, garantir que todos os partidos possam concorrer e resolver questões operacionais básicas, como se a votação seria manual ou eletrônica, disse Oswaldo Martínez, da consultoria ORC, com sede em Caracas. Esse processo, por si só, poderia levar até um ano, segundo duas fontes próximas às negociações. ESTABILIDADE Autoridades norte-americanas também afirmaram que qualquer transição política deve ser acompanhada de estabilidade econômica e social, o que levanta mais questões potenciais sobre o cronograma eleitoral. “O que ameaçaria uma república duradoura na Venezuela seria alguém ser eleito e herdar uma catástrofe total, econômica e social, colocando assim todo o projeto em risco”, afirmou o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, nesta semana. Alguns críticos dessa posição afirmam que Washington colocou de lado a oposição do país e reduziu a urgência por eleições livres em favor de acordos envolvendo petróleo e investimentos com o governo interino. No mês passado, o presidente Donald Trump anunciou uma iniciativa sem precedentes dos EUA para assumir o controle de um quinto das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela. “O governo Trump está, atualmente, priorizando a estabilidade econômica e acordos relacionados ao petróleo sob o governo de Delcy, com pouca urgência aparente para avançar em direção a uma nova votação”, disse Risa Grais-Targow, diretora para a América Latina da consultoria de risco político Eurasia Group. “Isso, somado a algumas das mudanças institucionais necessárias, sugere que novas eleições não serão realizadas antes do final de 2027, no mínimo, com a possibilidade de que demorem ainda mais.” PRIORIDADES CONFLITANTES María Corina Machado, a líder da oposição mais conhecida da Venezuela e ganhadora do Prêmio Nobel da Paz que vive no exílio, tem estado notavelmente ausente das negociações com o governo interino, já que seus esforços para retornar ao país têm enfrentado obstáculos. Alguns parlamentares dos EUA têm clamado por eleições e afirmam que Washington não obteve concessões democráticas significativas do governo de Rodríguez. “A estabilidade e a normalização econômica, fortemente centradas na participação comercial dos EUA, continuam sendo as prioridades”, disse Nicholas Watson, da consultoria Teneo, acrescentando que Washington e Caracas estão tratando a necessidade de transição política como um processo de “longo prazo” e “sem prazo definido”. “Nenhum dos dois está tomando medidas decisivas rumo a um processo eleitoral”, disse Watson.

item.title: Hornets G Kon Knueppel (hamstring) could miss start of season
item.description: Charlotte Hornets sharpshooter Kon Knueppel sustained a left hamstring injury during an offseason on-court activity and could miss the start of the regular season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Charlotte Hornets sharpshooter Kon Knueppel sustained a left hamstring injury during an offseason on-court activity and could miss the start of the regular season. The Hornets said Friday that Knueppel and forward Grant Williams (right hamstring) will miss the preseason before being re-evaluated during the first week of the regular season. The Hornets open the campaign on Oct. 21 against the host Brooklyn Nets. Knueppel, who turned 21 last month, became the first rookie to lead the NBA in 3-pointers last season when he knocked down 273. He shot 42.5% from long range while averaging 18.5 points, 5.3 rebounds and 3.4 assists. Knueppel finished second in NBA Rookie of the Year balloting behind former Duke teammate Cooper Flagg of the Dallas Mavericks. The 6-foot-6 Knueppel was the fourth overall pick of the 2025 draft. The plan is to depend on him in the lead role more often after the offseason trade of LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves. Williams, also hurt during an on-court activity, averaged 7.0 points and 3.9 rebounds in 36 games (three starts) for Charlotte last season. He is beginning his third full season with the Hornets after ACL and meniscus tears sustained in November 2024 led him to miss nearly 13 months. Williams, 27, has averaged 7.2 points and 3.7 rebounds in 416 career games (111 starts) in seven seasons with the Boston Celtics (2019-23), Dallas Mavericks (2023-24) and Hornets. --Field Level Media

item.title: Indian biscuit maker Anmol Industries files for $188 million IPO
item.description: Indian biscuit maker Anmol Industries has filed for an initial public offering worth up to 18 billion rupees ($187.87 million), draft papers showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian biscuit maker Anmol Industries (ANMO.NS) has filed for an initial public offering worth up to 18 billion rupees ($187.87 million), draft papers showed on Friday. The Baijnath Choudhary & Family Trust, Anmol's top investor with a roughly 84% stake, is the sole selling shareholder in the IPO. Anmol is not selling any new shares and will not receive proceeds. Founded in 1994, Kolkata-based Anmol has a portfolio of biscuits, cookies and cakes offered through 70 brands and also exports to 31 countries. Anmol's net profit jumped five-fold to 1.91 billion rupees in the year ended March 31, while revenue rose 28% to about 21 billion rupees. It competes with listed rivals such as Britannia (BRIT.NS) , ITC (ITC.NS) and Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities (MRSB.NS) in the world's most populous country. The IPO filing comes as primary market activity in India picks up pace after a muted first half of the year. Anmol had attempted to go public in 2018 through a 7.5 billion rupee IPO and had received market regulator approval, but did not go through with the plan. Intensive Fiscal Services, ICICI Securities and IIFL Capital Services are managing the offering. ($1 = 95.8125 Indian rupees)

item.title: Pete Alonso homers twice as Orioles stay hot with win over Yankees
item.description: Pete Alonso hit a two-run homer with two outs in the third inning and a long solo home run in the seventh and the Baltimore Orioles rolled to a 10-2 victory over the host New York Yankees in the opener of a doubleheader on Friday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Pete Alonso hit a two-run homer with two outs in the third inning and a long solo home run in the seventh and the Baltimore Orioles rolled to a 10-2 victory over the host New York Yankees in the opener of a doubleheader on Friday afternoon. Dylan Beavers added a grand slam with two outs in the fourth off New York rookie Brendan Beck (0-2) as the Orioles (79-81) won for the seventh time in 10 games and avoided clinching a second straight losing season. Baltimore continued its recent improvement after being eliminated from postseason contention when the Chicago White Sox beat the Kansas City Royals on Thursday afternoon. Jeremiah Jackson hit an inside-the-park solo homer in the sixth as the Orioles beat the Yankees for the third time in 11 meetings this season. Christian Franklin and Gunnar Henderson contributed RBI singles for the Orioles, who won their first game at Yankee Stadium this season after being outscored 39-10 during a four-game sweep May 1-4. Baltimore's Trevor Rogers allowed one run on five hits in four innings. He struck out four and walked one before Albert Suarez (3-0) followed with four scoreless innings. The Orioles went ahead when Alonso jumped on Beck's first-pitch slider and hit a 407-foot shot into the left field seats After taking a three-run lead on Christian Franklin's single to right field, Beavers hit his first career grand slam when he hammered a 1-1 curveball into the right field seats. Beck allowed seven runs on six hits in five innings, walking three and striking out eight in his second career start. Jackson hit Baltimore's second inside-the-park homer of the season when his fly ball to right-center deflected off rookie center fielder Spencer Jones' glove. The ball rolled into center field, and Jackson was rounding third as right fielder Amed Rosario retrieved the ball at the fence. Alonso gave the Orioles a 9-1 lead when he crushed a 1-1 changeup from reliever Yerry De Los Santos into the left field bleachers for a 471-foot shot. Alonso ended the game with an American League-leading 43 homers and tied St. Louis first baseman Alec Burleson for the major league lead with 113 RBIs. Rosario had an RBI single and Paul Goldschmidt hit a sacrifice fly for the Yankees (92-68), who took the loss after honoring Hall of Fame pitcher CC Sabathia in a pregame ceremony. Sabathia was honored by having his jersey number retired and also got a plaque in Monument Park. --Field Level Media

item.title: Internationals stun US with 5-0 sweep to take Presidents Cup lead
item.description: The International Team swept the US 5-0 in Friday's foursomes to seize a 7-3 lead in the Presidents Cup, a stunning turnaround after trailing by one point following the opening session.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Team swept the US 5-0 in Friday's foursomes to seize a 7-3 lead in the Presidents Cup, a stunning turnaround after trailing by one point following the opening session. On a cloudy day at Medinah Country Club's Course No. 3 outside Chicago, the Internationals dominated the alternate-shot session and quietened the home crowd as they moved within 8-1/2 points of their first Presidents Cup triumph since 1998. The US, seeking an 11th consecutive success, need to fight back when the competition resumes with two sessions on Saturday. The sweep echoed the 2024 event at Royal Montreal, when the Internationals responded to a 5-0 opening-day loss by sweeping the Americans 5-0 in Friday's foursomes. The teams are now separated by four points with 20 still available over the final two days. "We loved how we played yesterday. But we just wanted to come win the session. The team were all in a really good frame of mind, but you would never imagine doing five sets," International Team captain Geoff Ogilvy said. "We did it in Montreal, so maybe it's a pattern now. The boys played really well. It was an incredible day for us." FIVE FOR FIVE Hideki Matsuyama and Sungjae Im got the Internationals off to a winning start, overcoming an early deficit to beat Russell Henley and rookie Jacob Bridgeman 3&2. The Japanese-Korean pairing fell one down after the second hole but moved ahead on the fourth and controlled the match from there. Corey Conners and Nick Taylor then delivered another blow, beating world number one Scottie Scheffler and Sam Burns 1-up. Scheffler and Burns, who had finally won together in a team competition on Thursday after four previous losses, surrendered an early advantage and could not find a way back as the Canadians held on to win. Conners and Taylor never led by more than one hole, but held their nerve down the stretch, with Taylor's approach on 18 leaving him a short birdie putt before Burns missed his chance. "We just tried to be relentless out there," Conners said. "Both hit a lot of quality shots, and Nick made some key putts there towards the end to keep us in the position, highlighted by his approach shot into the last here. It was unbelievable." Ryan Fox and Min Woo Lee added another point for the Internationals, edging Collin Morikawa and Wyndham Clark 1-up in the day's closest match. Morikawa had a chance to close out the contest with a birdie on the final hole but could not convert, allowing Fox and Lee to take the point. Adam Scott and Christiaan Bezuidenhout then defeated Justin Thomas and Cameron Young 3&2, with the International pair taking control early and maintaining their advantage through the closing holes. Tom Kim and Si Woo Kim completed the sweep, beating Patrick Cantlay and Xander Schauffele 4&3 to remain unbeaten together this week. The win improved their Presidents Cup record as a partnership to 4-1, with the South Koreans again delivering in the anchor match after beating Cantlay and Chris Gotterup on Thursday. "Hats off to the International Team. They went out there and played great," Team US captain Brandt Snedeker said. "You're going to have sessions like this in these things. I feel terrible for the guys because I know they grinded out there and gave me everything they had today, and it wasn't meant to be. "There's still 20 points out there. There's a lot of golf left to play."

item.title: WTA roundup: Leylah Fernandez surges into Singapore semis
item.description: No. 6 seed Leylah Fernandez of Canada knocked out top-seeded Russian Mirra Andreeva 6-2, 7-5 in the quarterfinals of the Singapore Tennis Open on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: No. 6 seed Leylah Fernandez of Canada knocked out top-seeded Russian Mirra Andreeva 6-2, 7-5 in the quarterfinals of the Singapore Tennis Open on Friday. Fernandez converted six of 11 break points in the 92-minute match, including the clinching game to set up a semifinal meeting against No. 5 Maja Chwalinska of Poland. Chwalinska ousted No. 4 Elise Mertens of Belgium 6-2, 6-2 in 89 minutes. The other semifinal of the WTA 500 tournament will feature unseeded Tatiana Prozorova of Russia and Talia Gibson of Australia. Prozorova outlasted China's Xinyu Wang 3-6, 7-5, 6-4 in just over three hours, while Gibson eliminated No. 7 Maria Sakkari of Greece 6-1, 4-6, 6-2 in just under two hours. Korea Open Rain interrupted the quarterfinals in Seoul, with all matches moving to Saturday. No. 2 Kimberly Birrell of Australia was leading Katie Volynets 2-6, 6-2, 4-2 in the day's first match when play was suspended. The other quarterfinals feature No. 3 Lanlana Tararudee of Thailand against No. 5 Maya Joint of Australia; No. 4 Elena-Gabriela Ruse of Romania against No. 6 Anna Bondar of Hungary; and Australia's Taylah Preston against Russia's Alina Korneeva. Billie Jean King Cup The Czech Republic was the first country to reach the finals of the Billie Jean King Cup when Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova swept their singles matches against Spain in Shenzhen, China. Muchova took down Jessica Bouzas Maneiro 7-5, 6-4, and Noskova followed with a 7-6 (5), 6-2 win over Cristina Bucsa, amassing a 7-0 edge in aces. The doubles match was not needed as a result. The Czechs will face either Ukraine or defending champion Italy in Sunday's finals. Ukraine and Italy will play the other semifinal match Saturday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Pochettino regrets limited role in Balogun appeal, says controversy changed US energy
item.description: United States coach Mauricio Pochettino said he regretted not being more involved in the decision to appeal Folarin Balogun's World Cup red card, adding that the controversy changed the energy around his team before their last-16 loss to Belgium.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: United States coach Mauricio Pochettino said he regretted not being more involved in the decision to appeal Folarin Balogun's World Cup red card, adding that the controversy changed the energy around his team before their last-16 loss to Belgium. [USN:L1N43401I TEXT:"Balogun"] was sent off in the US's round-of-32 win over Bosnia but FIFA's disciplinary committee later suspended his one-match ban for a year, allowing the forward to play against Belgium. The decision triggered controversy after US President Donald Trump said he had intervened on behalf of the World Cup co-hosts by urging FIFA chief Gianni Infantino to review the case. "Perhaps I regret not having been more involved when the Bosnia match ended, in the situation that followed and generated everything negative that happened after," Pochettino said in an interview for "Futbol de Primera" on Thursday. The US had moved through the group stage before beating Bosnia, raising hopes that the team could reach the World Cup quarter-finals for the first time since 2002. Instead, the Americans lost 4-1 to Belgium in the last 16. Pochettino added that he understood how a change to the punishment following a referee's decision to send a player off at a World Cup - one that allowed the player to feature in the next match - could alter the outcome of that match. "No one understood why it happened, and as a football person, I know how things can shift the energy in an instant. After that, the energy changed. The match was then played under different parameters," he said. The 54-year-old Argentine coach added that he did not believe a different tactical approach, strategy or team selection would have changed the performance against Belgium. He said US Soccer should narrow the group responsible for making decisions about matters such as appealing red cards. "I think about the decisions made after the Bosnia match. These things need to be managed internally within a much more limited structure," Pochettino said. "The decisions need to come from very few people, from a sports perspective and with commonsense. This applies regardless of what a committee or a regulation may decide after." [USN:L4N44Z0KQ TEXT:"Belgium's football federation"] said earlier this month it would not support Infantino's bid for another term as FIFA president unless it received satisfactory answers over the Balogun case and other governance concerns. It said FIFA had not provided adequate justification for suspending Balogun's ban or explained how comparable cases would be handled in future and asked for the matter to be placed on the agenda for the next FIFA Council meeting on October 15. The US host Peru in a friendly in Orlando on Saturday before facing Chile on Tuesday and Mexico and Canada next week.

item.title: Moody's cuts Botswana rating again as diamond slump weighs on economy
item.description: Ratings agency Moody's on Friday downgraded Botswana's domestic- and foreign-currency long-term issuer ratings to "Baa2" from "Baa1", citing an expected deterioration in the country's public finances.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ratings agency Moody's on Friday downgraded Botswana's domestic- and foreign-currency long-term issuer ratings to "Baa2" from "Baa1", citing an expected deterioration in the country's public finances. The move marks Botswana's second downgrade by Moody's in less than a year, leaving the sovereign just two notches above junk status. It also comes days after Finance Minister Ndaba Gaolathe said Botswana [USN:L8N45E0DS TEXT:"expects"] a much smaller budget deficit in the current fiscal year, helped by higher-than-expected revenue from the central bank and measures to rein in spending. Botswana's economy, long viewed as an African success story, has been hit hard by a prolonged downturn in the global diamond market, driven by economic uncertainty and the growing popularity of lab-grown diamonds. Diamonds typically account for about one-third of Botswana's national revenue and three-quarters of its foreign exchange earnings. Moody's said weaker diamond-sector revenue, lower-than-expected receipts from the Southern African Customs Union (SACU), a key source of government income, and disappointing proceeds from newly introduced tax measures had weakened Botswana's fiscal position. The rating agency also warned that it could cut again if Botswana were to materially increase its investment in De Beers through debt-financed transactions, a sale Anglo American (AAL.L) is aiming to close in the final quarter of this year. The outlook was changed to stable from negative, citing a stronger fiscal policy response and that a more sustained recovery in diamond revenue could slow the pace of debt accumulation.

item.title: US lawmakers aim to keep China's datacenter tech out of sensitive government systems
item.description: A bipartisan group of US lawmakers introduced legislation on Friday to bar the federal government from equipping sensitive government systems with Chinese-made components used to transmit data in AI data centers.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Alper
item.content:encoded: A bipartisan group of US lawmakers introduced legislation on Friday to bar the federal government from equipping sensitive government systems with Chinese-made components used to transmit data in AI data centers. The devices, known as optical transceivers, allow data to travel over fiber-optic cables at the speed of light and are at the heart of the US AI infrastructure rollout, with some data centers requiring millions of them. The bill adds to growing pressure on Chinese optical transceiver makers, which dominate the market for parts critical to AI data centers. Supporters of the legislation say the devices could be harnessed by Beijing to disrupt access to US AI tools and the cloud. The restriction, sponsored by Republicans John Cornyn and Dave McCormick as well as Democrats John Fetterman and Ruben Gallego, would apply to optical transceivers made by China's Eoptolink and Zhongji Innolight (300308.SZ) . “We shouldn’t rely on China for technologies that are essential to our national security,” McCormick said, according to a press release. “Critical government communication and information systems must be safe, reliable, and free of any foreign interference, but the use of Chinese technology undermines that mission,” said Cornyn. Innolight, which was added to a Pentagon list of alleged Chinese military-backed companies, Eoptolink, and the Chinese Embassy did not immediately respond to requests for comment. But the US industry has argued such a move would slow the US AI infrastructure buildout, ceding ground to China, as hyperscalers scramble to find other suppliers. The Information Technology Industry Council, a tech lobbying group, sent a letter to the FCC on August 13 calling on the telecoms watchdog to "refrain from adding optical transceivers" to a trade blacklist, emphasizing the "potential effects that supply disruptions could have on data center deployment and U.S. AI leadership." U.S.-based firms Coherent and Lumentum sell competitive technology but lack the scale to replace Chinese vendors, according to a report by the Foundation for American Innovation. They did not immediately respond to requests for comment. If the legislation were approved, the government would have five years to comply and the Secretaries of Commerce and Defense would have the authority to add additional companies to the list.

item.title: ATP roundup: Jenson Brooksby charges into Chengdu QFs
item.description: Jenson Brooksby fired seven aces, saved four of six break points and wore down Italy's Lorenzo Sonego in a 5-7, 7-5, 6-2 victory to advance to the quarterfinals of the Chengdu Open on Friday in China.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jenson Brooksby fired seven aces, saved four of six break points and wore down Italy's Lorenzo Sonego in a 5-7, 7-5, 6-2 victory to advance to the quarterfinals of the Chengdu Open on Friday in China. Brooksby, seeking his second ATP Tour title and his first since March 2025, broke Sonego's serve in the 11th game of the second set and served out to force a third set, where the American dominated on his first-service points (12 of 14) to cruise to victory. Also Friday, France's Adrian Mannarino downed third seed and defending champion Alejandro Tabilo of Chile 6-4, 6-4. Mannarino fired 10 aces and saved all three break points he faced. Mannarino will face No. 7 seed Denis Shapovalov of Canada, who was a 6-2, 6-3 winner over Czech foe Vit Kopriva. Brooksby's next opponent will be Georgia qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili, who upset Dutch fourth seed Botic van de Zandschulp 6-4, 7-5. AITO Hangzhou Open No. 2 seed Andrey Rublev needed a tidy 77 minutes to dispatch Australia's Rinky Hijikata 6-3, 6-3 in the Round of 16 in China. The Russian smashed 12 aces without a double fault and advanced to face Frenchman Hugo Gaston, who upset No. 7 seed Jaime Faria of Portugal 4-6, 7-6 (5), 6-4. He saved four of five break points to counter Faria's 11 aces. Fellow Frenchman Kyrian Jacquet also pulled off an upset when he dominated No. 3 seed Tomas Martin Etcheverry of Argentina 6-2, 6-3. His next opponent, No. 6 seed Fabian Marozsan of Hungary, topped Japanese qualifier Taro Daniel 6-7 (2), 7-5, 7-6 (1). Laver Cup World No. 3 Carlos Alcaraz of Spain teamed with the Czech Republic's Jakub Mensik to defeat Taylor Fritz and Kazakhstan's Alexander Bublik 6-4, 6-4 in doubles, giving Team Europe a 3-1 lead over Team World on the first day of the Laver Cup in London. After Norway's Casper Ruud defeated Argentina's Francisco Cerundolo 6-7 (4), 6-4, 10-8 to open the day, American Brandon Nakashima scored Team World's only point of the day by outlasting Mensik 6-1, 3-6, 10-7. The final singles match of the day put Europe back ahead as Spaniard Rafael Jodar, in his Cup debut, took down Bublik 6-2, 6-3. Alcaraz and Mensik proceeded to break Fritz and Bublik's serve once in each set while going 5-for-5 in saving break points. Team Europe, which also features World No. 2 Alexander Zverev of Germany, will try to build an overwhelming lead Saturday when three singles matches and one doubles match are each worth two points. The competition concludes Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Governo anuncia Desenrola 3.0 para famílias e estima programa em R$300 bi
item.description: O governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva anunciou nesta sexta-feira o Desenrola Brasil 3.0, um novo programa para ajudar pessoas endividadas, com foco em dívidas que estejam com atraso de 2 anos a 4,5 anos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva anunciou nesta sexta-feira o Desenrola Brasil 3.0, um novo programa para ajudar pessoas endividadas, com foco em dívidas que estejam com atraso de 2 anos a 4,5 anos. O programa visa dívidas de cartão de crédito, nas modalidades parcelada e rotativa, e crédito pessoal sem consignação em folha. A estimativa do governo sobre o alcance do novo Desenrola é de R$300 bilhões. Segundo comunicado do governo, o programa terá leilão de compra das carteiras de crédito das instituições financeiras pela União em novembro, com repasse do desconto para as famílias. Com esse leilão, o governo disse que gastará R$15 bilhões para adquirir até R$150 bilhões em empréstimos inadimplentes com descontos de pelo menos 90%. Espera-se que o programa abranja cerca de metade do estoque de dívida considerado elegível. Após a apresentação do programa, Lula disse que o novo programa "é um Desenrola melhor do que os outros Desenrola". "Porque no outro Desenrola, as pessoas tinham que individualmente procurar um banco. Agora é o governo que vai comprar a dívida e vai acertar a vida das pessoas. É isso que eu entendi. É isso que eu assinei. É isso que vai ser publicado", disse. O ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti, também esteve presente no evento de apresentação do projeto, e destacou que a medida está dentro das regras fiscais. "Faremos ajustes até o limite da votação do orçamento, atendendo as necessidades do país. Os recursos serão incluídos dentro da regra fiscal", disse Moretti. No mesmo evento foi anunciada também a edição de uma medida provisória proibindo as apostas online. As medidas vêm a poucos dias do primeiro turno da eleição presidencial, em que Lula (PT) busca a reeleição numa disputa acirrada contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Football-Mbappé, blessé au genou, quitte les Bleus pour la suite de la Ligue des nations
item.description: Le capitaine de l'équipe de France Kylian Mbappé est forfait pour les trois prochaines rencontres de Ligue des nations en raison d'une blessure au genou contractée vendredi lors de la victoire des Bleus en Turquie (1-0), a annoncé Zinédine Zidane, le nouveau sélectionneur tricolore, sur TF1.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le capitaine de l'équipe de France Kylian Mbappé est forfait pour les trois prochaines rencontres de Ligue des nations en raison d'une blessure au genou contractée vendredi lors de la victoire des Bleus en Turquie (1-0), a annoncé Zinédine Zidane, le nouveau sélectionneur tricolore, sur TF1. L'attaquant du Real Madrid s'est blessé sur la frappe du pied droit qui lui a permis d'inscrire le seul but de son équipe, vendredi soir en seconde période, pour la première de "Zizou" en tant que sélectionneur. "Il souffre d’une lésion tendineuse et va repartir à Madrid pour se soigner", a déclaré le staff de l'équipe de France dans un communiqué. Quelques minutes auparavant, au micro de TF1, Zinédine Zidane avait déjà annoncé que le meilleur buteur de l'histoire des Bleus (67 buts) était contraint de quitter le rassemblement. "Ça ne va pas bien, malheureusement. Je pense qu'il va falloir qu'il rentre", a-t-il dit. "On ne va pas prendre de risques. Il s'est fait une hyperextension du genou." Les Bleus se déplacent en Belgique lundi avant de recevoir l'Italie puis la Belgique pour la suite de la Ligue des nations.

item.title: La Colombie extrade vers les USA un chef rebelle accusé de narcotrafic
item.description: La Colombie a extradé vers les Etats-Unis un narcotrafiquant présumé issu d'une faction dissidente de l'ancienne guérilla des Farc (Forces armées révolutionnaires de Colombie), a-t-on appris vendredi de trois sources policières.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Colombie a extradé vers les Etats-Unis un narcotrafiquant présumé issu d'une faction dissidente de l'ancienne guérilla des Farc (Forces armées révolutionnaires de Colombie), a-t-on appris vendredi de trois sources policières. Geovany Andres Rojas, alias "Spider", est accusé de diriger les Commandos de la frontière de la Coordination nationale de l'armée bolivarienne (CNEB), l'un des nombreux groupes formés par d'anciens combattants des FARC ayant rejeté ou abandonné l'accord de paix conclu avec le gouvernement en 2016. Il est accusé aux Etats-Unis de trafic de drogue et d'association de malfaiteurs pour des activités présumées en Colombie et en Equateur remontant à 2017. Il s'agit de la première extradition d'un haut commandant de groupe armé depuis l'entrée en fonction en août du président de droite Abelardo De La Espriella, qui a rompu avec la stratégie de négociation de son prédécesseur de gauche Gustavo Petro. Abelardo De La Espriella a mis fin aux pourparlers de paix avec les groupes armés illégaux dont les factions dissidentes des FARC et a lancé une offensive militaire pour reprendre le contrôle de zones de montagne et de jungle isolées.

item.title: Football-Les Bleus s'imposent en Turquie pour la première de Zidane sur le banc
item.description: Zinédine Zidane a entamé vendredi son mandat de sélectionneur de l'équipe de France par une victoire en Turquie (1-0), grâce à un but de Kylian Mbappé, lors de la première journée de la Ligue des nations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Zinédine Zidane a entamé vendredi son mandat de sélectionneur de l'équipe de France par une victoire en Turquie (1-0), grâce à un but de Kylian Mbappé, lors de la première journée de la Ligue des nations. Trente-deux ans après sa première sélection en tant que joueur et 20 ans après sa dernière, conclue par une expulsion pour un coup de tête en finale de la Coupe du monde 2006, "Zizou" a repris le fil de son histoire avec les Bleus. Le champion du monde 1998, nommé fin juillet pour succéder aux 14 ans de règne de Didier Deschamps, est devenu le premier sélectionneur à remporter son premier match à la tête des Bleus depuis Aimé Jacquet en février 1994. "C'est beaucoup d'émotion. C'est, en plus, une première réussie parce que ce n'est pas évident", a réagi Zinédine Zidane sur TF1. "J'ai vu plein de choses intéressantes alors qu'on a fait trois entraînements et demi, c'est encourageant. Je suis content de ce qu'ils ont fait." "C'est toujours la même émotion, je n'ai pas de mots. J'ai quelque chose de particulier qui se passe, on profite du moment", a-t-il poursuivi en évoquant ce qu'il avait ressenti pendant l'hymne national, lors duquel il est arrivé avec quelques secondes de retard. Seule ombre au tableau, la sortie juste avant l'heure de jeu de Kylian Mbappé, victime d'une lésion tendineuse au genou en ouvrant le score (54e). Très attendu pour sa première, plus de deux mois après la défaite de la France contre l'Angleterre (6-4) lors du match pour la troisième place du Mondial, Zinédine Zidane avait choisi d'installer son équipe en 4-3-3. Un système qu'il utilisait déjà prioritairement au Real Madrid lors de sa dernière expérience sur un banc, il y a plus de cinq ans. Parmi ses premières décisions fortes, celle de placer son capitaine Kylian Mbappé sur l'aile gauche et de positionner Ousmane Dembélé à la pointe de l'attaque tricolore. Cette position n'a pas empêché Kylian Mbappé d'inscrire le seul but de la rencontre, son 67e sous le maillot bleu. Décalé par Michael Olise, il a fermé son pied pour tromper Ugurcan Cakir. Malheureusement, l'attaquant du Real Madrid, candidat au Ballon d'or décerné dans un mois, s'est blessé sur l'action et a été contraint de quitter la pelouse, remplacé par Désiré Doué. Le staff de la sélection a annoncé qu'il quittait le rassemblement pour se soigner dans la capitale espagnole. PREMIÈRE POUR LEPAUL Paradoxalement, l'équipe de France a forcé le verrou turc alors qu'elle était moins dominatrice qu'en première période, Mike Maignan sortant une parade salvatrice trois minutes plus tôt sur une tête d'Abdülkerim Bardakci (51e). "À la mi-temps, il a corrigé quelques détails défensifs et quelques trucs offensifs", a expliqué Estéban Lepaul, sur TF1, concernant les consignes du sélectionneur. "Il laisse de la liberté aux joueurs, il veut que les joueurs prennent leur responsabilités." Durant les 45 premières minutes, les doubles champions du monde ont monopolisé le ballon sans se montrer très souvent dangereux aux abords de la surface de réparation adverse. Ils n'ont pas été aidés par une pelouse en mauvaise qualité. Les Bleus ont tout de même eu plusieurs occasions mais Kylian Mbappé a trop croisé sa frappe (17e) puis Rayan Cherki (41e), Michael Olise (43e) et Adrien Rabiot (44e) n'ont pas concrétisé leur temps fort. Après l'ouverture du score, Jules Koundé a également touché le poteau (69e). Dans une fin de partie disputée en supériorité numérique en raison de l'expulsion du gardien Ugurcan Cakir (87e), coupable d'une main en-dehors de sa surface sur un dribble de Bradley Barcola, Zinédine Zidane a offert une première sélection à l'attaquant du Stade rennais, Estéban Lepaul. Au-delà de lancer le mandat de "ZZ" de la meilleure manière, la France entame la Ligue des nations du bon pied avant de se déplacer en Belgique lundi.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street termine en hausse avec Microsoft et l'IA
item.description: La Bourse de New York a fini en hausse vendredi grâce à Microsoft et d'autres valeurs technologiques liées à l'IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a fini en hausse vendredi grâce à Microsoft et d'autres valeurs technologiques liées à l'IA. Le niveau élevé des cours du brut et des rendements du Trésor américain continue cependant d'inciter les investisseurs à la vigilance au terme d'une semaine en dents de scie. L'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) a gagné 0,93%, ou 478,64 points, à 51.828,62 points. Le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, a pris 39,28 points, soit 0,51% à 7.743,41 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) a avancé de son côté de 129,34 points, soit 0,48% à 27.068,716 points. Sur la semaine, le S&P 500 a progressé de 1,22%, le Nasdaq de 2,06% et le Dow Jones de 0,28%, selon les données provisoires de fin de séance. L'un des titres phares de la séance, Microsoft a dévoilé de nouvelles fonctionnalités de son application Copilot, notamment un outil de programmation et un agent IA disponible en permanence. Le groupe a gagné 3,7%. L'action Akamai Technologies (AKAM.O) a gagné plus de 3% après la conclusion d'un accord de 11,6 milliards de dollars (10,17 milliards d'euros) dans le domaine du cloud avec Anthropic, acteur majeur de l'IA. L'accord prévoit l'émission d'un bon de souscription qui pourrait permettre à Anthropic de détenir jusqu'à 5% du capital d'Akamai. "C'est un signe positif dans la mesure où les investissements se poursuivent et où des accords continuent d'être conclus", a commenté Thomas Martin, gestionnaire de portefeuille chez Globalt Investments à Atlanta. Le fabricant de puces Qualcomm (QCOM.O) a gagné 4 % et Dell (DELL.N) a progressé de 5%. Meta Platforms (META.O) a en revanche reculé de 3,3%, sans doute sur des prises de bénéfice. Le géant des réseaux sociaux avait bondi d'environ 13% cette semaine, porté par l'accueil favorable réservé à son agent d'IA Muse.

item.title: Stablecoin firm Circle finance chief Fox-Geen to step down
item.description: Stablecoin giant Circle Internet Group said on Friday its chief financial officer, Jeremy Fox-Geen, plans to step down after more than five years in the role.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Stablecoin giant Circle Internet Group (CRCL.N) said on Friday its chief financial officer, Jeremy Fox-Geen, plans to step down after more than five years in the role. Here are some other details: The New York-based company is working with an executive search firm as it seeks the successor to its finance chief. Fox-Geen, who joined Circle in May 2021, will continue as CFO through the end of 2026 to support the transition, unless a successor is appointed sooner. He played a vital role in Circle's growth over the past few years, including navigating a [USN:L3N3S814A TEXT:"$1.2 billion initial public offering"] last year. "Jeremy has played a key role in building Circle into the company it is today. He brought strategic insight, financial leadership, and operating discipline through periods of both market turmoil and tremendous growth," said CEO Jeremy Allaire. Fox-Geen said, "...Having achieved many milestones, it is now the right time for me to step down and take a break before my next chapter." Circle also said co-founder Sean Neville was stepping down as a director, effective immediately, for personal reasons. Neville's departure is part of an orderly process of board refreshment, the company disclosed in a regulatory filing. Circle is the issuer of USDC, a dollar-pegged stablecoin with a market capitalization of about $75 billion, according to CoinMarketCap data.

item.title: Chasing wild-card spot, D-backs place RHP Corbin Burnes on IL
item.description: Diamondbacks right-hander Corbin Burnes was scratched from his Saturday night start against the San Diego Padres when the former Cy Young Award winner was placed on the 15-day injured list Friday with shoulder inflammation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Diamondbacks right-hander Corbin Burnes was scratched from his Saturday night start against the San Diego Padres when the former Cy Young Award winner was placed on the 15-day injured list Friday with shoulder inflammation. The throwing shoulder issue comes as Arizona tries to secure the final National League wild-card spot. Riding a five-game winning streak, Arizona entered Friday two games back of the Philadelphia Phillies, but the Diamondbacks hold the tiebreaker if the teams are tied after the regular season ends Sunday. The move is retroactive to Tuesday. In a corresponding move, Arizona recalled right-hander Jose Cabrera from Triple-A Reno. Burnes, 31, signed a six-year, $210 million contract before the 2025 season to join the Diamondbacks, then made just 11 starts before undergoing Tommy John surgery that June. He did not make his 2026 season debut until Sept. 8 after a June injury to his right teres major muscle delayed his return. In three starts with the Diamondbacks this season, he is 0-0 with a 7.84 ERA in 10 1/3 innings. A fourth-round pick of the Brewers in the 2014 draft, Burnes won the NL Cy Young Award in 2021 and was a three-time All-Star in his six seasons with Milwaukee. In his lone season with the Baltimore Orioles in 2024, he made his fourth All-Star team. Overall, Burnes is 63-38 with a 3.20 ERA in 213 games (152 starts) over nine seasons with the Brewers (2018-23), Orioles (2024) and Diamondbacks. Zac Gallen and Ryne Nelson, former right-handed starters who have been shifted to the bullpen, could see innings Saturday in place of Burnes. Cabrera, 24, made his major league debut June 21 and is 0-3 with a 4.33 ERA in seven games (five starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Venezuela promete elecciones que enfrentarían largos retrasos: fuentes
